title: threshold
body:
## threshold

Keeps the cells of a mesh whose selected point or cell scalar lies inside the inclusive range [lower, upper], producing an unstructured grid. Schemaxis fixes ParaView's ThresholdMethod to Between, requires all three options, checks that lower does not exceed upper and that the named array exists with the stated association. Use it to isolate a region such as hot gas or a recirculation zone; use pvThreshold for inverted, one-sided or component-wise tests.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- For point arrays ParaView's AllScalars default (true) applies: a cell is kept only if all of its points are in range, which shrinks the region compared with a cell-array threshold.
- Cells are kept whole, so the boundary is stepped; use contour or clip for a smooth iso-boundary.

Native constructor: `Threshold`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input to the Threshold filter. Accepted data: any dataset (meshes, grids, point sets) (vtkDataSet); hyper-tree grids (adaptive AMR-like trees) (vtkHyperTreeGrid). The input needs at least one point- or cell-centred array. | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkDataSet","vtkHyperTreeGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `field` | Select the association and scalar array used to decide which cells are retained. | `{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string","minLength":1},"minItems":2,"maxItems":2}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE","REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `lower` | The lower limit of the retained scalar interval. The lower limit must not exceed the upper limit. | `{"type":"number"}` | `required` | `1` |
| `upper` | The upper limit of the retained scalar interval. The lower limit must not exceed the upper limit. | `{"type":"number"}` | `required` | `1` |

Cross-option checks:

```json
[
  {
    "kind": "ordered",
    "options": [
      "lower",
      "upper"
    ]
  }
]
```

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "threshold",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  },
  "options": {
    "field": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE",
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ],
    "lower": 1,
    "upper": 1
  }
}
```
